# Intisar Foundation

> > A UK-based humanitarian organization using drama therapy to support Arab women affected by conflict and trauma across the Middle East.

Intisar Foundation is a registered charity founded on the vision of HH Sheikha Intisar AlSabah to provide psychological healing and empowerment to women in war-affected regions. The organization operates across the Arab world, including Lebanon, Jordan, and Kuwait, using innovative drama therapy and creative arts programs to address trauma and build peace.
